name: ternary_derived_signals
description: Real trace: model defined derived signals (cart_side_change etc.) using unsupported ternary/comparison syntax, and returned derived_signals as a dict instead of a list. Parses fine; validation must reject the expressions.
goal: make cartpole sway left and right at constant speed
raw_response_text:
{
  "goal": "Make cartpole sway left and right at constant speed",
  "task_params": {
    "reference_sway_frequency_hz": 0.5,
    "reference_sway_amplitude_rad": 0.2,
    "cart_position_bound": 2.4,
    "max_cart_position_penalty": 1.0,
    "max_jerk_penalty": 1.0,
    "time_window_sec": 5.0
  },
  "derived_signals": {
    "reference_pole_angle": "reference_sway_amplitude_rad * sin(2 * 3.141592653589793 * reference_sway_frequency_hz * time_sec)",
    "pole_angle_error": "abs(pole_angle - reference_pole_angle)",
    "cart_side": "sign(cart_position)",
    "cart_side_change": "step > 1 ? sign(cart_position) != sign(prev_cart_position) ? 1.0 : 0.0 : 0.0",
    "cart_side_total_steps": "time_sec > 0 ? time_sec : 1.0",
    "cart_side_balance": "1.0 - abs((time_on_left - time_on_right) / max(time_on_left + time_on_right, 1))",
    "cart_position_clipped": "clip(cart_position, -cart_position_bound, cart_position_bound)",
    "jerk": "abs(current_action_0 - prev_action_0)",
    "low_motion_measure": "exp(-abs(cart_velocity))"
  },
  "reward_terms": [
    {
      "key": "alternating_motion",
      "label": "Alternating Motion Reversals",
      "description": "Encourages repeated reversals of cart direction (left-right sway).",
      "weight": 1.0,
      "enabled": true,
      "expression": "cart_side_change"
    },
    {
      "key": "balanced_side_occupancy",
      "label": "Balanced Side Occupancy",
      "description": "Rewards roughly equal time spent on left and right sides.",
      "weight": 1.0,
      "enabled": true,
      "expression": "1.0 - abs(sign(cart_position) - sign(prev_cart_position)) * 0.0"
    },
    {
      "key": "bounded_cart_motion",
      "label": "Bounded Cart Motion",
      "description": "Rewards cart position staying within bounds near center.",
      "weight": 1.0,
      "enabled": true,
      "expression": "clip(1.0 - square(cart_position / cart_position_bound), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "key": "periodic_sway_tracking",
      "label": "Periodic Sway Tracking",
      "description": "Rewards tracking a periodic reference sway with constant amplitude and frequency.",
      "weight": 0.9,
      "enabled": true,
      "expression": "clip(1.0 - pole_angle_error / reference_sway_amplitude_rad, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "key": "smooth_control",
      "label": "Smooth Control",
      "description": "Favors low jerk control for consistent swaying.",
      "weight": 0.8,
      "enabled": true,
      "expression": "clip(1.0 - jerk, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "key": "jerky_control",
      "label": "Jerky Control Penalty",
      "description": "Penalizes rapid action changes causing jerky control.",
      "weight": -1.0,
      "enabled": true,
      "expression": "-jerk"
    },
    {
      "key": "one_sided_cart_motion",
      "label": "One-Sided Cart Motion Penalty",
      "description": "Penalizes spending most time on one side of the track.",
      "weight": -1.0,
      "enabled": true,
      "expression": "-abs(sign(cart_position))"
    },
    {
      "key": "missing_return_phase",
      "label": "Missing Return Phase Penalty",
      "description": "Penalizes failure to complete return half of sway oscillation.",
      "weight": -1.0,
      "enabled": true,
      "expression": "-max(0.0, 0.5 - abs(cart_velocity))"
    },
    {
      "key": "runaway_cart",
      "label": "Runaway Cart Penalty",
      "description": "Penalizes cart moving too far from center.",
      "weight": -0.8,
      "enabled": true,
      "expression": "-clip(square(cart_position / cart_position_bound), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "key": "low_motion",
      "label": "Low Motion Penalty",
      "description": "Penalizes minimal cart velocity, avoids lack of swaying.",
      "weight": -0.7,
      "enabled": true,
      "expression": "-low_motion_measure"
    }
  ],
  "success_metric": {
    "key": "sway_consistency_score",
    "description": "Measure combining sway amplitude accuracy, frequency adherence, and left-right alternation frequency for stable constant speed sway.",
    "expression": "clip(1.0 - pole_angle_error / reference_sway_amplitude_rad, 0.0, 1.0) * cart_side_change"
  },
  "rationale": "Reward terms support achieving a smooth, constant speed left-right sway by encouraging alternating cart direction changes and balanced side occupancy. Bounded cart motion keeps the cart near center ensuring controlled sway. Tracking a sinusoidal reference sway favors accurate periodic motion. Smooth control and penalties on jerky actions promote consistent actuation. Penalties for one-sided motion, missing return phases, runaway cart, and low motion avoid behaviors that break the constant sway cycle or cause instability.",
  "warnings": []
}
